objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document defining locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures and process sequence with details and responsible persons

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures within a framework and process sequence

objs.name: document
objs.description: General information object that can be created, edited, released and distributed

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment that is released with the main document and has its own versioning

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-controlled document supplement that does not require release cycle or dual control

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Planned amendment to a document managed without affecting version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to review document validity after defined period

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role responsible for creating and editing document content

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User with additional personal change rights on a document

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for deciding whether document is distributed to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role responsible for translating released document content to another language

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User authorized to view approved documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with assigned authorizations for documents

objs.name: reader_group
objs.description: User group with read access to documents

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: User group with read access to archived documents

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to receive document distribution

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants during release process

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Record of document actions and modifications for traceability

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Specific revision of a document with associated status and validity dates

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Central metadata and properties of a document

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Pre-defined structure that can be selected when creating new documents

objs.name: office_file
objs.description: Document in standard MS Office format that can be edited and converted

objs.name: pdf_file
objs.description: Converted and published version of document

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Document translated to a specific language

objs.name: client
objs.description: System client in multi-client system where document visibility is defined

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User interface displaying role-specific document information

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new information object with selection of document type

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using editing client

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Addition or modification of metadata and attributes of a document

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related authorizations to document

evts.name: convert_document
evts.description: System conversion of document to PDF format

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Making document visible to addressed readers after release

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participant

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of planned amendment to existing document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Approval and implementation of change proposal into new version

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Checking of document content according to technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and release of document by releaser

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of valid released document for editing

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System generation of validity extension request when document nears expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration of extended validity and update of valid until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User creation of request to invalidate document

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Invalidation and archiving of document no longer valid

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of invalidated document and creation of new version

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Sending email notification of new document version to distribution list

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Sending workflow task to distribution list for active confirmation of document receipt

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by recipient of document acknowledgement

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content to another language

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Review and approval of translated document version

o2o.description: Attachment is controlled document associated with main document
Additional information supplements main document
Change proposal belongs to and is displayed in document
Validity extension request is linked to document for review
Override request is created for invalidated document
Reactivation request selects document for re-validation
Version represents specific revision of document
Master data contains properties and attributes of document
Document is created from template
Language version is translated version of document
Distribution list defines users receiving document
Electronic signature is applied and documented with released version
Audit trail records actions and modifications of document
Policy is document type at strategic level
Guideline is document type for locally defined regulations
Work instruction is document type for detailed procedures
Procedural instruction is document type for process sequence
Author is assigned from author user group
Reviewer is assigned from reviewer user group
Releaser is assigned from releaser user group
Translator is assigned from translator user group
Reader is assigned from reader user group
User groups are members of distribution list
Reader group is specialized user group
Archive group is specialized user group with archive access
Office file is converted to PDF file

o2e.description: Document is created as new information object
Document is revised to create new version
Validity extension request is created by system
Override request is processed and override is declared
Distribution list is requested for acknowledgement
Language version is created through translation
Language version is reviewed and approved
Template is selected when creating document
Office file is converted to PDF
Master data is maintained as document properties
